nodes.title: 2026-10-10 main session, delegated, on G2 Khand's C10 frame-rate result (claude/r4-khand @f0bad197, docs/design/round4/build/khand/RESULTS.md): headless SwiftShader measured 54-55 fps at 360 px, 40-47 at 412, 16-18 at 1366, fill-bound at the tier-3d DPR floor 1.0. Decision: the floor stays at 1.0 and nothing is blurred or downscaled on SwiftShader evidence, because SwiftShader rasterises on the CPU and its fill rate does not predict a phone GPU (Mali/Adreno) or a laptop iGPU. C10 is reported as 'not measured on device' (SwiftShader kept as a proxy only), never as met. A frame-time governor that lowers render scale only on measured over-budget p95 on the real device may be proposed to G1 (G1 owns tier-3d), flag default off. Reverse if: the real-phone run (owner item, a ~Rs 10k Android) shows Khand under 30 fps at DPR 1.0 in the lesson slot, in which case the governor ships on by default for that tier.
